def ByteArray32 := { arr : ByteArray // arr.size = 32 }

def ByteArray16 := { arr : ByteArray // arr.size = 16 }

def ByteArray8 := { arr : ByteArray // arr.size = 8 }

def clamp01 (x : ℝ) : ℝ := max 0 (min 1 x)

theorem clamp01_bounds (x : ℝ) : 0 ≤ clamp01 x ∧ clamp01 x ≤ 1 := by
  unfold clamp01
  constructor
  · apply max_le_iff.mpr
    left
    norm_num
  · apply le_min_iff.mpr
    constructor
    · norm_num
    · exact le_refl (min 1 x)

theorem clamp01_idempotent (x : ℝ) : clamp01 (clamp01 x) = clamp01 x := by
  unfold clamp01
  cases' max_cases 0 (min 1 x) with h h
  · simp [h]
  · simp [h]
    cases' min_cases 1 x with h2 h2
    · simp [h2]
    · simp [h2]

theorem clamp01_eq1 (x : ℝ) (hx : x ≥ 1) : clamp01 x = 1 := by
  unfold clamp01
  have h1 : min 1 x = 1 := by
    apply min_eq_left
    linarith
  rw [h1]
  apply max_eq_right
  norm_num

theorem clamp01_eq0 (x : ℝ) (hx : x ≤ 0) : clamp01 x = 0 := by
  unfold clamp01
  have h1 : min 1 x = x := by
    apply min_eq_right
    linarith
  rw [h1]
  apply max_eq_left
  linarith

theorem clamp01_mid (x : ℝ) (hx0 : 0 ≤ x) (hx1 : x ≤ 1) : clamp01 x = x := by
  unfold clamp01
  have h1 : min 1 x = x := by
    apply min_eq_right
    linarith
  rw [h1]
  apply max_eq_right
  linarith

opaque hashTripletFields (subject relation object : String) (confidence : ℝ) (extraction_time : Int) : ByteArray32

opaque hashTripletIdentity (subject relation object : String) : ByteArray32

axiom hashTripletIdentity_injective {s1 r1 o1 s2 r2 o2 : String} :
  hashTripletIdentity s1 r1 o1 = hashTripletIdentity s2 r2 o2 ↔ s1 = s2 ∧ r1 = r2 ∧ o1 = o2

inductive ExtractionStage where
  | tokenization
  | triplet_extraction
  | validation
  | integration
  | indexing
  deriving DecidableEq, Inhabited, Repr

def ExtractionStage.toString : ExtractionStage → String
  | .tokenization => "tokenization"
  | .triplet_extraction => "triplet_extraction"
  | .validation => "validation"
  | .integration => "integration"
  | .indexing => "indexing"

def ExtractionStage.fromString (s : String) : Option ExtractionStage :=
  let t := s.trim
  if t.toLower = "tokenization" then some .tokenization
  else if t.toLower = "triplet_extraction" then some .triplet_extraction
  else if t.toLower = "validation" then some .validation
  else if t.toLower = "integration" then some .integration
  else if t.toLower = "indexing" then some .indexing
  else none

theorem ExtractionStage.fromString_toString (e : ExtractionStage) :
  ExtractionStage.fromString (ExtractionStage.toString e) = some e := by
  cases e
  all_goals simp [toString, fromString]

theorem ExtractionStage.toString_fromString {s : String} {e : ExtractionStage}
  (h : ExtractionStage.fromString s = some e) :
  ExtractionStage.toString e = s.trim.toLower := by
  simp [fromString] at h
  split at h
  all_goals
    try { injection h with h; rw [←h]; simp [toString] }
    try { contradiction }

def ExtractionStage.next : ExtractionStage → Option ExtractionStage
  | .tokenization => some .triplet_extraction
  | .triplet_extraction => some .validation
  | .validation => some .integration
  | .integration => some .indexing
  | .indexing => none

theorem ExtractionStage.next_not_self (e : ExtractionStage) :
  ExtractionStage.next e ≠ some e := by
  cases e
  all_goals simp [next]

theorem ExtractionStage.next_isSome (e : ExtractionStage) :
  (ExtractionStage.next e).isSome ↔ e ≠ .indexing := by
  cases e
  all_goals simp [next]

structure RelationalTriplet where
  subject : String
  relation : String
  object : String
  confidence : ℝ
  source_hash : ByteArray32
  extraction_time : Int
  metadata : Std.HashMap String String
  deriving Inhabited

def RelationalTriplet.init (subject relation object : String) (confidence_in : ℝ) : RelationalTriplet :=
  let now := 0
  let conf := clamp01 confidence_in
  let hash := hashTripletIdentity subject relation object
  {
    subject := subject
    relation := relation
    object := object
    confidence := conf
    source_hash := hash
    extraction_time := now
    metadata := Std.HashMap.empty
  }

theorem RelationalTriplet.init_confidence_bounds (s r o : String) (c : ℝ) :
  let t := RelationalTriplet.init s r o c
  0 ≤ t.confidence ∧ t.confidence ≤ 1 := by
  unfold init
  apply clamp01_bounds

theorem RelationalTriplet.init_confidence_clamped (s r o : String) (c : ℝ) :
  (RelationalTriplet.init s r o c).confidence = clamp01 c := by
  unfold init
  simp

def RelationalTriplet.initWithHash (subject relation object : String) (confidence_in : ℝ)
  (source_hash : ByteArray32) (extraction_time : Int) : RelationalTriplet :=
  let conf := clamp01 confidence_in
  {
    subject := subject
    relation := relation
    object := object
    confidence := conf
    source_hash := source_hash
    extraction_time := extraction_time
    metadata := Std.HashMap.empty
  }

theorem RelationalTriplet.initWithHash_confidence_bounds (s r o : String) (c : ℝ) (h : ByteArray32) (t : Int) :
  let triplet := RelationalTriplet.initWithHash s r o c h t
  0 ≤ triplet.confidence ∧ triplet.confidence ≤ 1 := by
  unfold initWithHash
  apply clamp01_bounds

theorem RelationalTriplet.initWithHash_preserves_hash (s r o : String) (c : ℝ) (h : ByteArray32) (t : Int) :
  (RelationalTriplet.initWithHash s r o c h t).source_hash = h := by
  unfold initWithHash
  simp

theorem RelationalTriplet.initWithHash_preserves_time (s r o : String) (c : ℝ) (h : ByteArray32) (t : Int) :
  (RelationalTriplet.initWithHash s r o c h t).extraction_time = t := by
  unfold initWithHash
  simp

def RelationalTriplet.clone (t : RelationalTriplet) : RelationalTriplet :=
  {
    subject := t.subject
    relation := t.relation
    object := t.object
    confidence := t.confidence
    source_hash := t.source_hash
    extraction_time := t.extraction_time
    metadata := t.metadata
  }

theorem RelationalTriplet.clone_eq (t : RelationalTriplet) : t.clone = t := by
  unfold clone
  cases t
  simp

def RelationalTriplet.computeHash (t : RelationalTriplet) : ByteArray32 :=
  hashTripletFields t.subject t.relation t.object t.confidence t.extraction_time

def RelationalTriplet.setMetadata (t : RelationalTriplet) (key value : String) : RelationalTriplet :=
  { t with metadata := t.metadata.insert key value }

theorem RelationalTriplet.setMetadata_get (t : RelationalTriplet) (k v : String) :
  (t.setMetadata k v).metadata.get? k = some v := by
  unfold setMetadata
  simp

theorem RelationalTriplet.setMetadata_preserves_fields (t : RelationalTriplet) (k v : String) :
  let t2 := t.setMetadata k v
  t2.subject = t.subject ∧
  t2.relation = t.relation ∧
  t2.object = t.object ∧
  t2.confidence = t.confidence ∧
  t2.source_hash = t.source_hash ∧
  t2.extraction_time = t.extraction_time := by
  unfold setMetadata
  simp

def RelationalTriplet.getMetadata (t : RelationalTriplet) (key : String) : Option String :=
  t.metadata.get? key

theorem RelationalTriplet.getMetadata_setMetadata (t : RelationalTriplet) (k v : String) :
  (t.setMetadata k v).getMetadata k = some v := by
  unfold getMetadata setMetadata
  simp

def RelationalTriplet.equals (t1 t2 : RelationalTriplet) : Bool :=
  t1.subject = t2.subject ∧ t1.relation = t2.relation ∧ t1.object = t2.object

theorem RelationalTriplet.equals_reflexive (t : RelationalTriplet) : t.equals t = true := by
  unfold equals
  simp
  tauto

theorem RelationalTriplet.equals_symmetric (t1 t2 : RelationalTriplet) :
  t1.equals t2 ↔ t2.equals t1 := by
  unfold equals
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases h with ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
    exact ⟨h1.symm, h2.symm, h3.symm⟩
  · intro h
    rcases h with ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
    exact ⟨h1.symm, h2.symm, h3.symm⟩

theorem RelationalTriplet.equals_transitive (t1 t2 t3 : RelationalTriplet) :
  t1.equals t2 → t2.equals t3 → t1.equals t3 := by
  unfold equals
  intro h12 h23
  rcases h12 with ⟨s12, r12, o12⟩
  rcases h23 with ⟨s23, r23, o23⟩
  exact ⟨s12.trans s23, r12.trans r23, o12.trans o23⟩

def RelationalTriplet.hashEquals (t1 t2 : RelationalTriplet) : Bool :=
  t1.source_hash = t2.source_hash

theorem RelationalTriplet.hashEquals_reflexive (t : RelationalTriplet) : t.hashEquals t = true := by
  unfold hashEquals
  simp

theorem RelationalTriplet.hashEquals_symmetric (t1 t2 : RelationalTriplet) :
  t1.hashEquals t2 ↔ t2.hashEquals t1 := by
  unfold hashEquals
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact h.symm
  · intro h
    exact h.symm

theorem RelationalTriplet.hashEquals_transitive (t1 t2 t3 : RelationalTriplet) :
  t1.hashEquals t2 → t2.hashEquals t3 → t1.hashEquals t3 := by
  unfold hashEquals
  intro h12 h23
  exact h12.trans h23

structure ValidationResult where
  triplet : RelationalTriplet
  is_valid : Bool
  confidence_adjusted : ℝ
  validation_method : String
  conflicts : List RelationalTriplet
  anomaly_score : ℝ
  validation_time : Int
  deriving Inhabited

def ValidationResult.init (t : RelationalTriplet) : ValidationResult :=
  {
    triplet := t
    is_valid := true
    confidence_adjusted := t.confidence
    validation_method := ""
    conflicts := []
    anomaly_score := 0
    validation_time := 0
  }

theorem ValidationResult.init_is_valid (t : RelationalTriplet) :
  (ValidationResult.init t).is_valid = true := by
  unfold init
  simp

theorem ValidationResult.init_confidence (t : RelationalTriplet) :
  (ValidationResult.init t).confidence_adjusted = t.confidence := by
  unfold init
  simp

def ValidationResult.addConflict (vr : ValidationResult) (c : RelationalTriplet) : ValidationResult :=
  { vr with conflicts := c :: vr.conflicts }

theorem ValidationResult.addConflict_increases_length (vr : ValidationResult) (c : RelationalTriplet) :
  (vr.addConflict c).conflicts.length = vr.conflicts.length + 1 := by
  unfold addConflict
  simp

theorem ValidationResult.addConflict_preserves_triplet (vr : ValidationResult) (c : RelationalTriplet) :
  (vr.addConflict c).triplet = vr.triplet := by
  unfold addConflict
  simp

def ValidationResult.hasConflicts (vr : ValidationResult) : Bool :=
  vr.conflicts.length > 0

theorem ValidationResult.hasConflicts_addConflict (vr : ValidationResult) (c : RelationalTriplet) :
  (vr.addConflict c).hasConflicts = true := by
  unfold hasConflicts addConflict
  simp

def ValidationResult.conflictCount (vr : ValidationResult) : ℕ :=
  vr.conflicts.length

theorem ValidationResult.conflictCount_addConflict (vr : ValidationResult) (c : RelationalTriplet) :
  (vr.addConflict c).conflictCount = vr.conflictCount + 1 := by
  unfold conflictCount addConflict
  simp

def ValidationResult.setValidationMethod (vr : ValidationResult) (method : String) : ValidationResult :=
  { vr with validation_method := method }

theorem ValidationResult.setValidationMethod_eq (vr : ValidationResult) (m : String) :
  (vr.setValidationMethod m).validation_method = m := by
  unfold setValidationMethod
  simp

structure KnowledgeGraphIndex where
  subject_index : Std.HashMap String (List RelationalTriplet)
  relation_index : Std.HashMap String (List RelationalTriplet)
  object_index : Std.HashMap String (List RelationalTriplet)
  all_triplets : List RelationalTriplet
  deriving Inhabited

def KnowledgeGraphIndex.init : KnowledgeGraphIndex :=
  {
    subject_index := Std.HashMap.empty
    relation_index := Std.HashMap.empty
    object_index := Std.HashMap.empty
    all_triplets := []
  }

theorem KnowledgeGraphIndex.init_empty (k : KnowledgeGraphIndex) :
  k = init → k.all_triplets = [] := by
  intro h
  rw [h]
  unfold init
  simp

def KnowledgeGraphIndex.indexIntoMap (m : Std.HashMap String (List RelationalTriplet))
  (key : String) (triplet : RelationalTriplet) : Std.HashMap String (List RelationalTriplet) :=
  match m.get? key with
  | some list => m.insert key (triplet :: list)
  | none => m.insert key [triplet]

theorem KnowledgeGraphIndex.indexIntoMap_get (m : Std.HashMap String (List RelationalTriplet))
  (k : String) (t : RelationalTriplet) :
  let m2 := indexIntoMap m k t
  m2.get? k = some (t :: (m.get? k).getD []) := by
  unfold indexIntoMap
  cases m.get? k
  · simp
  · simp

def KnowledgeGraphIndex.index (kgi : KnowledgeGraphIndex) (t : RelationalTriplet) : KnowledgeGraphIndex :=
  {
    subject_index := indexIntoMap kgi.subject_index t.subject t
    relation_index := indexIntoMap kgi.relation_index t.relation t
    object_index := indexIntoMap kgi.object_index t.object t
    all_triplets := t :: kgi
